methodology.countryMeaning: Historical chess affiliation, not a FIDE federation registration or birthplace.
methodology.completeness: All world ranks through each country’s fifth member are audited; other country top fives are not inferred.
methodology.temporalLimit: Some cutoff assignments infer continuity from national careers around January; per-row notes identify these cases. Exact-month registration records are not claimed.
methodology.neutralCases: Where only exclusion from a target country pool is established, countryCode remains null.
